slides.title: Persistence protects recovery
slides.visibleText: Saved state → recovery. Replicas do not replace backups.
slides.composition: Two labeled native constructions: a disk/restore sequence and a primary/replica serving path. Put their distinct objectives beneath them.

intent.takeaway: Saved data and serving availability solve different failure problems.
intent.audienceQuestion: Which mechanism helps after each kind of failure?
intent.rationale: Matched actors and labeled connections make the two mechanisms visible without conflating them.

alternative.reason: Readers would have to infer the mechanisms and actors from sentences.

visual.purpose: Distinguish restore from continued serving; keep the limit visible.

asset.description: Editable disk/recovery and primary/replica nodes; optional approved disk/database symbols after catalog inspection.
asset.reason: Native relationships carry the factual explanation; an illustrative photograph would obscure the mechanisms.
